title: Actor
description: One actor's config file, .troupe/actors/<name>.yaml. The file's name is the actor's name. Its character, when it has one, is the whole of .troupe/actors/<name>.md. troupe writes this file from the theatre's config events, and every field is set with troupe config set.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Where this file's schema is, relative to the file, so editors can check it. troupe writes it.

runner.title: Runner
runner.description: The runner that runs this actor, by name.

options.title: Runner options
options.description: The runner's own options, passed to it unchanged. Absent means {}. An extension point: the runner's published options schema fills it, and without one only {} validates.

expect.title: Effect check
expect.description: Files, relative to the theatre's root, that a run must create or change: each must exist after the run, and differ from before it. A file named twice is checked once. An empty list means no effect check, and has to be written.

runnerOptions.title: The runner's options
runnerOptions.description: The default for the runnerOptions extension point: no options.
